questions.q: What is the December 1 Income Property luncheon about?
questions.theirs: December 1 is a World Cup economic-impact luncheon with April Putney and Steve Strohmaier, at Perkins Coie and via Zoom. The event page lists $55 for members and $65 for nonmembers and November 25 at 9 am closing without a timezone. The exact linked registration form says registration has closed.
questions.ours:
The December 1 Income Property luncheon is about the **economic impact of the 2026 World Cup**. The panelists are April Putney and Steve Strohmaier.

The discussion runs from 12:15–1 p.m. at Perkins Coie and virtually via Zoom. [Event details](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107101&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=yXI0jDaoHyCa&link=https%3A%2F%2Fwa-mba.org%2Fall-events%2Fip-luncheon-december-2026%2F%3Foccurrence%3D2026-12-01)

**Visitor:** I am not a member. What does it cost, and can I attend online?

**Subsights:** The nonmember price is **$65**, and the event lists a virtual option via Zoom.

However, the [December registration form](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107103&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=yXI0jDaoHyCa&link=https%3A%2F%2Fami.jotform.com%2F263134523756963) said registration had closed when checked November 25. For questions about attending online after the deadline, contact WMBA at **admin@wa-mba.org** or **(206) 401-5521**.
questions.outcome: The continuing answers preserve the exact December event and closed registration. No registration or payment was performed.

questions.ours:
For the **December 1 Income Property Luncheon**, the listed deadline was November 25 at 9:00 a.m., but its timezone wasn’t specified, so the deadline’s relationship to 9:30 a.m. Pacific is unclear.

The [registration form](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107106&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=yXI0jDaoHyCa&link=https%3A%2F%2Fami.jotform.com%2F263134523756963) was observed closed at 11:34 a.m. Pacific on November 25. Its status at 9:30 a.m. is not established. For a late-attendance question, contact WMBA at admin@wa-mba.org or (206) 401-5521.

**Visitor:** Please pay and add it to my Outlook.

**Subsights:** I can’t pay or add the event to your Outlook calendar. [Registration was observed closed](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107108&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=yXI0jDaoHyCa&link=https%3A%2F%2Fami.jotform.com%2F263134523756963); for late attendance or payment questions, contact WMBA at admin@wa-mba.org or (206) 401-5521.

You can download and import the [December 1 Outlook calendar event](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107108&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=yXI0jDaoHyCa&link=https%3A%2F%2Fwa-mba.org%2F%3Fmethod%3Dical%26id%3D8035%26occurrence%3D2026-12-01) yourself.
questions.outcome: The answers avoid inferring the deadline timezone and provide the native calendar export without claiming an import.

**Visitor:** Just use the December registration form.

**Subsights:** The [December registration form](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107115&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=yXI0jDaoHyCa&link=https%3A%2F%2Fami.jotform.com%2F263134523756963) is for **December 1, not January 14**, and it says registration has closed.

**Visitor:** Then give me the correct January page to check, rather than the December form.

**Subsights:** [January 14 Income Property Luncheon page](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107137&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=yXI0jDaoHyCa&link=https%3A%2F%2Fwa-mba.org%2Fall-events%2Fip-luncheon-january-2027%2F%3Foccurrence%3D2027-01-14)

questions.q: We provide software to lenders, but do not originate, sell or service loans. Which membership?
questions.theirs: General membership covers loan origination, sale or servicing at $1,695/year; Associate covers other organizations serving mortgage lenders at $1,195/year. The year starts September 1 and national MBA is separate. The application requires board approval before dues. The sponsor note spells WWBA; membership names Tony Fernandez, while committees names Chad Jackson.
questions.ours:
**Associate membership** appears to be the appropriate category for a software provider serving mortgage lenders. Annual dues are **$1,195**, and the fiscal year starts September 1.

Applications go to the WMBA Board for approval, and dues are paid only after notification of approval. The membership page mentions a current-member sponsor for one year but refers to “WWBA,” so confirm that requirement with WMBA at admin@wa-mba.org or (206) 401-5521.

[Apply for WMBA membership](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107128&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=yXI0jDaoHyCa&link=https%3A%2F%2Fwa-mba.org%2Fbecome-a-member%2F)

**Visitor:** Does it include national MBA membership and who do I ask about a sponsor?

**Subsights:** No. **WMBA and national MBA memberships are separate.**

For the sponsor requirement, ask WMBA at **admin@wa-mba.org** or **(206) 401-5521**. Its membership page mentions a current-member sponsor for one year but calls the organization “WWBA,” so the requirement needs confirmation. The page names Tony Fernandez for membership questions.

[WMBA membership details](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107130&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=yXI0jDaoHyCa&link=https%3A%2F%2Fwa-mba.org%2Fmembership%2F)

**Visitor:** Is Tony the current membership chair? The committee page shows Chad Jackson.

**Subsights:** The [committees page](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107139&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=yXI0jDaoHyCa&link=https%3A%2F%2Fwa-mba.org%2Fcommittees%2F) lists **Chad Jackson of CMG Home Loans** as Membership chair. The [membership page](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107139&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=yXI0jDaoHyCa&link=https%3A%2F%2Fwa-mba.org%2Fmembership%2F) names Tony Fernandez for membership questions; it does not establish that he is the current chair.

To confirm who handles your sponsor question, contact WMBA at **admin@wa-mba.org** or **(206) 401-5521**.
questions.outcome: The initial role-based answer identifies Associate membership and the native application. A later clarification distinguishes the two published contacts and asks WMBA to resolve the sponsor requirement. No application or payment was performed.
